newsitem.title: EU: Official Journal contents - OJ L 154 of June 12, 1997.
newsitem.headline: Official Journal contents - OJ L 154 of June 12, 1997.

text.p: * (Note - contents are displayed in reverse order to that in the printed Journal)

* Corrigendum to Commission Regulation (EC) No 1044/97 of 10 June 1997 amending Regulation (EC) No 2498/96 establishing Community tariff quotas for 1997 for sheep, goats, sheepmeat and goatmeat falling within CN codes 0104 10 30, 0104 10 80, 0104 20 90 and 0204 and derogating from Regulation (EC) No 1439/95 laying down detailed rules for the application of Council Regulation (EEC) No 3013/89 as regards the import and export of products in the sheepmeat and goatmeat sector (Official Journal of the European Communities No L 152 of 11 June 1997)

COMMISSION DECISION of 4 June 1997 suspending the buying-in of butter in certain Member States (Only the Danish, German, Greek, French, English, Dutch, Finnish and Swedish texts are authentic) (97/366/EC)

COMMISSION DECISION of 26 March 1997 drawing up provisional lists of third country establishments from which the Member States authorize imports of products prepared from meat of bovine animals, swine, equidae and sheep and goats (Text with EEA relevance) (97/365/EC)
COMMISSION DECISION of 5 February 1997 concerning the financing of shipbuilding in Denmark during 1987 to 1993 (Only the Danish text is authentic) (Text with EEA relevance) (97/364/EC)
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1062/97 of 11 June 1997 amending representative prices and additional duties for the import of certain products in the sugar sector
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1061/97 of 11 June 1997 establishing the standard import values for determining the entry price of certain fruit and vegetables
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1060/97 of 11 June 1997 fixing the import duties in the rice sector
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1059/97 of 11 June 1997 adjusting the maximum annual fishing effort for certain fisheries

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1058/97 of 11 June 1997 fixing the maximum export refunds for olive oil for the 14th partial invitation to tender under the standing invitation to tender issued by Regulation (EC) No 2081/96
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1057/97 of 11 June 1997 fixing the export refunds on olive oil
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1056/97 of 11 June 1997 adapting to technical progress Council Regulation (EEC) No 3821/85 on recording equipment in road transport (Text with EEA relevance)
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1055/97 of 11 June 1997 on the issue of import licences for high-quality fresh, chilled or frozen beef and veal
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1054/97 of 11 June 1997 concerning the classification of certain goods in the combined nomenclature
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1053/97 of 10 June 1997 establishing unit values for the determination of the customs value of certain perishable goods

COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1052/97 of 11 June 1997 fixing the maximum export refund for white sugar for the 42nd partial invitation to tender issued within the framework of the standing invitation to tender provided for in Regulation (EC) No 1464/96
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1051/97 of 11 June 1997 fixing the export refunds on white sugar and raw sugar exported in its unaltered state
COMMISSION REGULATION (EC) No 1050/97 of 11 June 1997 fixing the representative prices and the additional import duties for molasses in the sugar sector

COUNCIL REGULATION (EC) No 1049/97 of 9 June 1997 amending Regulation (EC) No 3069/95 establishing a European Community observer scheme applicable to Community fishing vessels operating in the Regulatory Area of the Northwest Atlantic Fisheries Organization (NAFO)

COUNCIL REGULATION (EC) No 1048/97 of 9 June 1997 amending Regulation (EEC) No 189/92 adopting provisions for the application of certain control measures adopted by the Northwest Atlantic Fisheries Organization END OF DOCUMENT.
